kjv_def: by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely
strongs_def: entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event
it_def:
1) insieme
   1a) in qualsiasi ed ogni via, per tutti i mezzi
   1b) indubbiamente, certamente
   1c) in nessuno modo, non affatto
